title: Add option to drop NaNs from user data in Chain.pca()
body: The scikit-learn PCA() function that Chain.pca() utilizes raises a well-written ValueError about how the function cannot handle NaN values in the data. Currently, Chain.pca() will do nothing before this error is raised. Consider adding an optional argument and utils function to drop all NaNs from user input data before performing PCA. Would be a similar implementation to the correlation functions which already drop NaN data.
